rows.label: A siren echoes from another street.
The light of a lamppost brings the colors of a recent graffiti artwork alive.
Posters announce different parties on the same club over a brick wall.
An artistic sticker is signed with a social media handle in unintelligible writing.
Dogs bark at a delivery motorcycle.
Someone in business attire gets into an Uber.
The window of an apartment puffs out thick smoke as it opens.
A long, slow line forms outside a nightclub, and cigarette smoke comes from it.
A cat licks itself on top of a wall. Upon seeing you, it jumps and vanishes over the roof.
Loud teenagers go quiet as they pass by older girls.
A young clerk locks a gate, hops on a bike, and rides away.
Someone in a bathrobe and slippers waits for their dog to poop.
A girl in party clothes types on her phone, alone, under an awning.
A plastic bag floats along the sidewalk.
A drunk person stumbles at the curb but doesn’t fall.
A car beeps, locks click, and someone slips a key into their pocket.
A rat emerges from beneath a container and vanishes into the curbside shadows.
Three girls on a corner pass around a thin joint. One of them coughs.
A middle-aged man in a heavy metal t-shirt jogs by.
Across the street, a woman and her friend gather papers scattered on the ground.
Two people, each holding a beer, kiss intensely, and fall down.
A young man crosses the street and meets his friends. A drunk girl yells with joy.
A crying woman leaves a nightclub, followed in a hurry by a man in loafers.
Someone in costume poses for a photo, says goodbye to strangers, and moves on.
A bottle shatters under a car tire, and tiny shards scatter over the black asphalt like stars.
Two guys share a quick, clumsy handshake, as something passes from one hand to the other.
Someone in disheveled formal wear sighs at a bus stop.
A few blocks away, two people nearly get into a fight, but a third intervenes.
A small group in religious garments walks silently.
Friends form a small circle outside a bar. The breeze from there smells green.
Someone talks to themselves in the third person, feet staggering.
A skater passes by. The back of their shirt features a manga page.
The yowling of a cat in heat echoes between the buildings.
A security guard sighs and lights a cigarette.
Two cyclists zoom past, laughing.
Puddles reflect the moon, and footsteps distort the images.
Someone knocks on a door, then waits while checking all their pockets.
Heels click on the sidewalk, leaving a trail of perfume.
Music escapes from a hurried passerby’s headphones.
A bus hisses as the doors close, then accelerates.
A poorly modified car drives by, vibrating with bass.
A flyer flaps against a pole, advertising a strange new age book.
A dog sniffs an overflowing trash bin, bites something, and runs away.
A naked mannequin behind a store window looks menacing in the shop's darkness.
A phone screen lights up two faces that look at each other, then laugh.
A man with a hand in his pocket leans against a wall, looking impatiently around.
A strange-looking vehicle drifts down the street, drawing all kinds of stares.
A car does a bootleg turn. A baby cries inside.
A large silhouette with three or four heads writhes and moans in the deep end of an alley.
A car stops. Young men jump out and start dancing in the street, entertaining passersby.
